Based on the onboarding documentation, this happens because **`provider: auto` automatically overrides local endpoints whenever it detects remote API keys in your environment**. 

To prevent Hermes from defaulting to remote providers (like OpenRouter) for tasks and force it to use your local setup:

1. Open `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.
2. Set the provider explicitly to `custom` and specify your local endpoint URL:
   ```yaml
   provider: custom
   base_url: http://localhost:11434  # Replace with your local llama.cpp endpoint/port
   ```

*(Note: If you have specific questions about hardcoded fallback models like `gemini-3-flash-preview` in `_resolve_auto()`, this internal codebase detail is not covered in the onboarding document, but explicitly setting `provider: custom` in `config.yaml` ensures your local endpoint is used instead of falling back to remote auto-detection).*
